title: Concept: jQuery append of markup
description: A jQuery append call that takes markup in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: append parses its argument as HTML, so a value built from request data becomes live DOM in the page's origin.
applicability: Deployments that render a jQuery append call that takes markup into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: append parses its argument as HTML, so a value built from request data becomes live DOM in the page's origin.
